title: Outage Communications Standard for Medical and Life-Support Protections
content:
Individual outage notification under Medical and Life-Support Protections depends on the protection held: the hours of advance notice before a planned maintenance outage, whether public safety power shutoffs are individually notified, whether a designated third party may receive copies of notices, and how individual outage notifications are delivered.

| Protection | Notice before a planned maintenance outage (hours) | Individual notification of public safety power shutoffs | Copies of disconnection and outage notices to a designated third party | How individual outage notifications are delivered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medical Emergency Certificate | 0 (no individual notice) | no | allowed | not applicable |
| Standard Medical Baseline Allowance | 0 (no individual notice) | no | allowed | not applicable |
| Heating and Cooling Medical Baseline Allowance | 0 (no individual notice) | no | allowed | not applicable |
| Combined Medical Baseline Allowance | 0 (no individual notice) | yes | allowed | automated call, text and email to the contact numbers on file |
| Life-Support Registration | 48 | yes | allowed | automated call, text and email to the contact numbers on file, followed by a live call when unanswered |
| Critical Care Life-Support Registration | 72 | yes | allowed | live call to the customer and to any designee, repeated until reached |

## Reading the standard

- **Planned maintenance outages.** Individual advance notice is given under the Life-Support Registration (48 hours before) and the Critical Care Life-Support Registration (72 hours before). A figure of 0 means no individual notice of planned maintenance outages.
- **Public safety power shutoffs.** Individually notified under the Combined Medical Baseline Allowance, the Life-Support Registration and the Critical Care Life-Support Registration.
- **Designee copies.** Under all six protections a designated third party may receive copies of disconnection and outage notices.
- **Delivery.** The Combined Medical Baseline Allowance uses automated call, text and email; the Life-Support Registration adds a live call when the automated contact is unanswered; the Critical Care Life-Support Registration relies on a live call to the customer and to any designee, repeated until reached.

### Hypothetical illustration

A planned maintenance outage is scheduled to begin at 08:00 on a Friday. Under the Critical Care Life-Support Registration the individual notice is due 72 hours before, by 08:00 on the Tuesday; under the Life-Support Registration it is due 48 hours before, by 08:00 on the Wednesday.
